findings.quote: The Parties wish to explore potential collaborative and commercial opportunities in financial technology and software integration (the "Permitted Purpose"). In doing so, either Party may disclose non-public, commercially sensitive or proprietary information to the other. This Agreement establishes the ground rules to protect that information.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB03 Purpose limitation (pass 0.97, breach 0.02, unclear 0.01).

findings.quote: 1.1.1 "Confidential Information" means all information of a confidential or proprietary nature disclosed directly or indirectly by or on behalf of one Party (the "Discloser") to the other Party (the "Recipient"), whether disclosed orally, in writing, electronically or by any other means, and whether marked as confidential or that reasonably ought to be understood as confidential given its content or the circumstances of disclosure. It includes business models, financial data, pricing, customer lists, software code, APIs, architecture, product roadmaps, algorithms and trade secrets.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB02 Definition of Confidential Information (pass 0.47, breach 0.48, unclear 0.05).
Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB05 Permitted disclosure to Representatives and Group (pass 0.47, breach 0.33, unclear 0.20).
Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB04 Carve-outs (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 4.1 The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required by an applicable law, binding court order, or formal request from a competent regulatory or supervisory authority.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB06 Compelled disclosure (pass 0.66, breach 0.22, unclear 0.12).

findings.quote: 4.2 Before making any disclosure under Clause 4.1, where lawful to do so, the Recipient shall promptly notify the Discloser in writing so the Discloser may seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy. The Recipient shall provide reasonable cooperation to the Discloser, at the Discloser's sole expense, in any lawful effort to resist, narrow or safeguard the disclosure.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB06 Compelled disclosure (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote:
5.1 Upon the Discloser's written request at any time, the Recipient shall promptly:
5.1.1 securely destroy or return all materials containing or reflecting Confidential Information in its custody or control; and
5.1.2 provide written confirmation that it has complied with this Clause 5.1 within ten (10) business days.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB07 Return and destruction (pass 0.43, breach 0.54, unclear 0.03).

findings.quote: 5.2 The Recipient may keep copies of Confidential Information to the extent required by applicable law, regulatory compliance or automated electronic system backups created in the ordinary course of business. Any retained copies remain subject to the obligations of this Agreement until destroyed.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB07 Return and destruction (pass 0.16, breach 0.75, unclear 0.09).

findings.quote: 6.1 All Confidential Information remains the exclusive property of the Discloser.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB08 Ownership, licences and IP (pass 0.95, breach 0.00, unclear 0.05).

findings.quote: 6.2 Neither this Agreement nor any disclosure grants the Recipient any licence, title or intellectual property right in or to any Confidential Information, except the limited right to use it strictly for the Permitted Purpose.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB08 Ownership, licences and IP (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 6.3 Information is shared on an "as is" basis without warranty of any kind regarding accuracy or completeness.

findings.why: Jev reads the clause as meets fallback against PB09 Warranty and reliance disclaimers (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 7.1 This Agreement takes effect on the date set out above and remains in effect for two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party giving thirty (30) days' prior written notice.

findings.quote: 7.2 Each Party's duty of confidentiality under this Agreement continues for three (3) years after the date of termination or expiry, except that trade secrets remain protected for as long as they constitute a trade secret under applicable law.
